name: 04 Conversation and Lavish
intro: Your two ways of talking to the factory: the conversation with Coordination, with its focused job, one-line updates, catch-up, unsent text and second attach; and the Lavish server, which renders decision requests and collects your answers. One question comes from a silence in the sources; everything else is stated as already decided. When you accept it I commit it and start 05 Repositories and job branches.
notes: Rule 4: AssemblyAI#9 says the daemon never types into the conversation while you have unsent text, and AssemblyAI#10 says delivery never waits on whether you are present. The draft reads them together: a nudge waits only while you have text in the box, until you submit or leave.
Rule 15 lists what counts as leaving the conversation, gathered from AssemblyAI#10 (detach, the Ctrl-] menu, a newer attach) and S9 (an SSH drop leaves delivery running).
Rule 17 adds holds and their causes to the catch-up's contents from AssemblyAI#10, as AssemblyAI#14 requires.
How the daemon talks to the pinned Lavish to render pages and collect answers, and which port Lavish uses, are left to implementation; the forwarding command names the port.
Coordination's wording (one-liners, job tags, focus announcements) is not set here: 08 says what its instructions must contain, and the wording is written during implementation.
